name: Week Start
description: The first day of the week a reader uses for display. Stored week values are always ISO 8601 (Monday start, YYYY-Www); this dimension describes a reader's convention and never changes stored data.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: The reader's week convention has not been set; display ISO 8601 weeks unchanged.

values.label: Monday
values.description: Weeks start on Monday. This is ISO 8601 and matches stored week values.

values.label: Sunday
values.description: Weeks start on Sunday. A reader shifts the displayed week boundary one day earlier.

values.label: Saturday
values.description: Weeks start on Saturday. A reader shifts the displayed week boundary two days earlier.

examples.dataset: a reader in a region whose calendars start on Sunday
